grc:other:υ.gloss: Lower-case upsilon (ὖ ψιλόν), the 20th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the close back rounded vowel /u/ and later the close front rounded vowel /y/. It is preceded by τ and followed by φ.

grc:other:Υ.gloss: The letter now called upsilon (ὖ ψιλόν (û psilón)), the 20th letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.

grc:noun:ὖ.gloss: name of the letter Υ / υ

grc:noun:ὗ.gloss: alternative form of ὖ (û, “upsilon”, name of the letter υ)
